text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After an outing on our day off, I walk<n>Rice Shower
back home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I had fun today, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I had fun today, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heyyy! Is that you, Rice? Perfect<n>timing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep! H-Hishiama?! Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. Didn't mean to spook you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you'd come lend a hand<n>in the
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do you mean cooking?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, remember? Today's the day I<n>treat everyone
in our dorm to some<n>home cookin'.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I just bought a load of ingredients<n>and could use a
hand!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um... But what if I make a mess?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, are you talkin' about what<n>happened last
time?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the kitchen was white as<n>snow,
wasn't it? But that flour bag<n>was already ripped, ya
know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like that happens all the time!<n>Besides, it was
more funny than<n>anything else.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! You should make those<n>croquettes
again. They were to die<n>for!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'd love to try them again... Howabout it? Will ya help me out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... I'll just make a mess...
choice_data_list: I want to try your croquettes.
Just think of it as helping a friend.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You do?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Hehe, well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll make a bunch and bring you some<n>another day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Another day? How about right now?<n>I'm pretty
sure we have the<n>ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In that case... You should join us, Big<n>Brother! That
way you can eat them<n>fresh!
choice_data_list: Okay! And I'll help cook too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In that case... You should join us, Big<n>Sister! That
way you can eat them<n>fresh!
choice_data_list: Okay! And I'll help cook too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, you two! You know<n>trainers aren't
allowed in the dorm!
Huh?! Oh, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I get to try one of Rice Shower's<n>croquettes a few
days later. They're<n>just as delicious as I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I can be of any help...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay... Hishiama, I might just get in<n>the way, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Who cares if a bag or two of<n>flour bursts!
As long as you're<n>helpin'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ya know, Rice... You've got yourself a<n>nice trainer,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Not that long ago, you would lock<n>yourself up in
your room whenever<n>anything bad happened.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was worried about whether you'd<n>be able to meet
a proper trainer... heh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did! Big Brother is really kind and<n>reliable...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did! Big Sister is really kind and<n>reliable...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, you're totally blushin'! Keep up<n>the
compliments, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I can go on forever about Big<n>Brother's
good qualities!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I can go on forever about Big<n>Sister's good
qualities!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: He's a hard worker, smart, has a<n>cute smile...
She's a hard worker, smart, has a<n>cute smile...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower keeps up the<n>compliments for a while
after.
